Sweden's Centre-Left Leader Fails Again to Form Government

Magdalena Andersson, the leader of Sweden's Social Democrats, has announced that the conditions are not in place for her to form a government, marking a second unsuccessful attempt. This prolongs a political deadlock in the country.
